body.title: Sighting store and per-repository lock
body.summary: Implement the per-repository sighting file at ~/.insrc/team/seen/<16 hex sha256 of realpath>.json: read with shape validation (damaged is distinguishable from absent), unique-temp-name overwrite writer for refresh, create-only hard-link publish for the reader, removal, the anchor merge rule (a known anchor is never replaced by an unknown one), and the exclusive lock with the 30 second stale rule.
acceptanceChecks: Two repositories, including a symlinked path, get distinct keys from the real path.
A damaged sighting reads as damaged evidence, never as absent.
Create-only publish never overwrites an existing or damaged sighting; the overwrite writer uses a unique temp name.
The lock refuses a second holder, and takes over a lock older than 30 seconds.
